articles.title: A bitcoin short squeeze for the ages as futures open interest collapses
articles.snippet: Falling open interest and subdued funding rates suggest the rally remains structurally healthy.

articles.title: Crypto rally spills into dog and cat memecoins as smaller tokens double in a week
articles.snippet: Robinhood Chain-based Cash Cat jumped more than 50% in a day, while several smaller animal-themed tokens have gained between 50% and 130% over the past week.

articles.title: DGrid AI token jumps 93% after launch as decentralized AI network goes live
articles.snippet: DGAI nearly doubled in its first day of trading as DGrid expands its distributed AI inference network and rolls out hardware for its personal AI agent.

articles.title: Shipyard winds down IPFS work after Protocol Labs ends funding
articles.snippet: The funding loss leaves InterPlanetary File System software without dedicated maintainers and puts the future of key public services in Protocol Labs’ hands.

articles.title: Korean bank taps Ripple for payments, Pakistan opens crypto licensing: Asia Express
articles.snippet: Asia’s biggest crypto hubs are locked in a tax-cut arms race, while Ripple will help Korea’s Jeonbuk Bank move money across borders.
